purpose: Close the 2M++ source, angular-completeness, coordinate, CF4-overlap, population-support, and Carrick-reference input gates before implementing a joint velocity-plus-density information solver.

authorization.authorization_basis: The user approved the recommended independent_z0_density_tracer_information_budget_design stage on 2026-09-01.

selected_tracer_route.primary: raw 2M++ real-galaxy counts with official ARES/BORG angular completeness maps and a conservative CF4-disjoint subset
selected_tracer_route.Carrick_density_cube_role: provenance-bound coordinate and qualitative reference only; never an exact truth or zero-uncertainty likelihood datum
selected_tracer_route.reason: The raw-count route retains an explicit selection, bias, shot-noise, RSD, and model-discrepancy contract. The published Carrick cube is already a reconstructed and 4 cMpc/h-smoothed product and lacks a released voxel covariance.

no_double_counting.policy: Before any 2M++ density use, exclude every 2M++ target attached to any CF4 non-unmatched class, not only secure_joint_mark. CF4 individual positions remain fixed likelihood design and are never a separate density factor.

tracer_design.coordinate_frame: supergalactic Cartesian, observer at box centre
tracer_design.radial_boundary_reason: Retain at least one N32 cell between every accepted tracer and the periodic box face.
tracer_design.population_definition: two apparent-magnitude samples times three equal-width absolute-K bins
tracer_design.Ksmag_semantics: published corrected K2M++ apparent magnitude; Galactic extinction, surface-brightness dimming, and mean evolution corrections are already included by the source catalogue
tracer_design.radial_selection_future_model: Schechter luminosity function with Mstar=-23.28 and alpha=-0.94, evaluated separately for all six populations
tracer_design.angular_selection_future_model: official NSIDE=512 RING completeness map evaluated at every tracer and every empty N32 voxel direction
tracer_design.shot_noise_future_baseline: Poisson counts after angular and radial selection thinning
tracer_design.bias_future_model: six positive luminosity-dependent nuisance parameters; a universal scalar bias is forbidden
tracer_design.RSD_future_model: linear coherent radial displacement plus a calibrated FoG/model-discrepancy term; redshift-space positions may not be silently treated as exact real-space positions

angular_completeness_gate.comparison: official map sampled in Galactic coordinates against the per-galaxy c11.5 or c12.5 catalogue mark
